counterexample: Attach a bounded cubical interval at every vertex of any locally finite cocompact CAT(0) cube complex quasi-isometric to H^2. The resulting simply connected, locally finite, cocompact cube complex remains quasi-isometric to H^2, while every attachment vertex is a global cut point and the intervals form separate strongly connected components.
